e.summary: 欧洲央行数据门户：欧元区金融与宏观统计入口，其中「保险公司与养老金统计（ICPF）」页面实测标注为已停止（discontinued）
e.summary_en: The ECB’s data portal: the entry point for euro area financial and macro statistics, whose "Insurance Corporations & Pension Funds Statistics (ICPF)" page is measured as marked discontinued
e.summary_hk: 歐洲央行數據門戶：歐元區金融與宏觀統計入口，其中「保險公司與養老金統計（ICPF）」頁面實測標註為已停止（discontinued）
e.body:
**ECB Data Portal（欧洲央行数据门户）** 是**欧元区官方金融与宏观统计入口**，也是本轮**数据层缺口**取向的第三条——实测池内 **ECB 相关条目为 0**（池内欧洲侧此前有欧盟监管口径 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、行业联合会 [[insurance-europe]] 与统计局 [[eurostat]]，**但欧洲央行的金融统计入口缺位**）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：门户首页 `data.ecb.europa.eu` **272.2KB**；**数据集页 `…/data/datasets/ICPF` 74KB**；**保险相关数据集检索页 `…/data/datasets?search=insurance` 360.9KB**。⚠️ **本轮最值得如实记录的一点**：ICPF 数据集页的**页面标题实测为「Insurance Corporations & Pension Funds Statistics (discontinued) - ICPF | ECB Data Portal」**——**即该数据集已被标注为「已停止」（discontinued）**；门户导航中实测另有 **「Non-bank financial corporations」** 分类（保险公司与养老金统计已并入更广的非银金融机构统计体系）。**故本词条明确写出「ICPF 已停更」，不把它当作现行数据源推荐**，只作为**历史序列与统计体系演变的入口**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上欧元区央行口径的金融统计**——欧洲保险公司**大量持有债券与利率敏感负债**，做**资产负债管理、利率情景与信用风险**时，**欧元区层面的金融统计**（利率、收益率曲线、货币与信贷、非银金融机构）是常用输入；ECB 门户与 [[eurostat]]（统计局口径）、[[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]（保险监管口径）**三者口径不同但互补**，**「同一市场、三种口径」恰好是很好的方法学练习**（同一指标在三处的定义与覆盖差异）。**② 「数据集被停更」这件事本身有信息量**——ICPF 从独立数据集并入非银金融机构统计，反映**监管统计体系的重组**；对写文献综述的学生，**「某数据集已 discontinued」是必须检查的一步**，本条目把这个事实**直接写在标题与摘要里**，避免误用。**③ 与欧元区宏观序列配套**——可为 [[solvency2rfr]]、[[eiopa-monthly-rfr-check]]（无风险利率）与 [[vasicekfit]]、[[nelson-siegel-svensson]]（曲线建模）提供实证输入。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**门户首页、ICPF 数据集页与其「discontinued」标注、保险相关数据集检索页**，**但未下载任何数据、未核实替代 ICPF 的具体数据集编号**；**②** 门户为**前端应用结构**（首页 272KB、检索页 361KB），**部分数据可能需要登录或通过 API**，**本次未核实取数路径与许可**；**③** 「discontinued」标注是**页面标题的字面事实**，**其停止时间与替代关系未进一步核实**（**故不作时间推断**）；**④** ECB 数据**以欧元区成员国上报为基础，存在口径与修订差异**。**核实说明**：门户首页（272.2KB）、ICPF 数据集页（74KB，标题含 discontinued）、保险数据集检索页（360.9KB）均 HTTP 200 实测；**未下载数据、未核实替代数据集与许可**。

e.body_en:
**The ECB Data Portal** is the **official entry point for euro area financial and macro statistics**, and the third entry in this round’s **data-layer gap** approach — a measured search found **zero ECB-related entries** (the European side of the corpus held the EU supervisory angle in [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]], the industry federation in [[insurance-europe]] and the statistical office in [[eurostat]], but **the central bank’s financial statistics were missing**).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the portal homepage `data.ecb.europa.eu` is **272.2KB**; the **dataset page `…/data/datasets/ICPF`** is 74KB; the **insurance dataset search page `…/data/datasets?search=insurance`** is 360.9KB. ⚠️ **The most important thing to record honestly this round**: the ICPF dataset page’s **measured title is "Insurance Corporations & Pension Funds Statistics (discontinued) - ICPF | ECB Data Portal"** — i.e. **the dataset is marked discontinued**; the portal navigation also shows a **"Non-bank financial corporations"** section (insurance and pension statistics having been folded into the broader non-bank financial institution framework). **This entry therefore states plainly that ICPF is no longer updated and does not recommend it as a current source**, presenting it only as an entry point to historical series and to the evolution of the statistical framework.

For RIAA: **① it adds central-bank-level euro area financial statistics** — European insurers **hold large bond portfolios against interest-sensitive liabilities**, so **euro-area financial statistics** (rates, yield curves, money and credit, non-bank financial institutions) are common inputs for **ALM, interest-rate scenarios and credit risk**; the ECB portal, [[eurostat]] (statistical office) and [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]] (insurance supervision) are **three different but complementary lenses on one market** — **the same market measured three ways is itself a good methodological exercise** in how definitions and coverage differ. **② The fact that a dataset was discontinued is informative** — ICPF moved from a standalone dataset into non-bank financial corporation statistics, reflecting a **reorganisation of supervisory statistics**; for anyone writing a literature review, **checking whether a dataset is marked discontinued is a required step**, and this entry puts that fact **directly in its title and summary** to prevent misuse. **③ It pairs with euro area macro series** — supplying empirical input to [[solvency2rfr]] and [[eiopa-monthly-rfr-check]] (risk-free rates) and to [[vasicekfit]] and [[nelson-siegel-svensson]] (curve modelling).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the portal homepage, the ICPF dataset page and its "discontinued" marker, and the insurance dataset search page**, **but downloaded no data and did not identify the specific dataset that replaced ICPF**; **②** the portal is a **front-end application** (homepage 272KB, search page 361KB) where **some data may require sign-in or the API**, and **the extraction path and licensing were not verified**; **③** the "discontinued" marker is **a literal fact of the page title**, and **its date and replacement relationship were not investigated further** (**so no timing inference is made**); **④** ECB data **rests on member-state reporting and carries definitional and revision differences**. **Verification note**: the homepage (272.2KB), the ICPF dataset page (74KB, title containing "discontinued") and the insurance dataset search page (360.9KB) were all measured at HTTP 200; **no data was downloaded and neither the replacement dataset nor licensing was verified**.

e.body_hk:
**ECB Data Portal（歐洲央行數據門戶）** 是**歐元區官方金融與宏觀統計入口**，也是本輪**數據層缺口**取向的第三條——實測池內 **ECB 相關條目為 0**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：門戶首頁 **272.2KB**；**數據集頁 `…/data/datasets/ICPF` 74KB**；**保險相關數據集檢索頁 360.9KB**。⚠️ **本輪最值得如實記錄的一點**：ICPF 數據集頁的**頁面標題實測為「Insurance Corporations & Pension Funds Statistics (discontinued) - ICPF」**——**即該數據集已被標注為「已停止」**；門戶導航實測另有 **「Non-bank financial corporations」** 分類。**故本詞條明確寫出「ICPF 已停更」，不把它當作現行數據源推薦**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上歐元區央行口徑的金融統計**——歐洲保險公司**持有大量債券與利率敏感負債**，做**資產負債管理、利率情景與信用風險**時，**歐元區金融統計**是常用輸入；ECB 門戶與 [[eurostat]]（統計局口徑）、[[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]（保險監管口徑）**三者互補**——**「同一市場、三種口徑」是很好的方法學練習**。**② 「數據集被停更」本身有信息量**——ICPF 併入非銀金融機構統計，反映**監管統計體系的重組**；本條目把該事實**直接寫在標題與摘要裡**，避免誤用。**③** 可為 [[solvency2rfr]]、[[eiopa-monthly-rfr-check]] 與 [[vasicekfit]]、[[nelson-siegel-svensson]] 提供實證輸入。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**門戶首頁、ICPF 頁與其 discontinued 標注、保險數據集檢索頁**，**但未下載任何數據、未核實替代 ICPF 的具體數據集編號**；**②** 門戶為**前端應用結構**，**部分數據可能需登入或走 API**，**未核實取數路徑與許可**；**③** discontinued 是**頁面標題的字面事實**，**其停止時間與替代關係未進一步核實**（**故不作時間推斷**）；**④** ECB 數據**存在口徑與修訂差異**。**核實說明**：三項均 HTTP 200 實測；**未下載數據、未核實替代數據集與許可**。
